test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: In which year was the Central Information Commission constituted for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005 **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Central Government established **the **CIC **in **2005 **in accordance with the **stipulations of the Right to Information Act (2005).**
 
• There is **no constitutional body **for it.
 
• It consists of **a Chief Information Commissioner **and **not more than ten Information Commissioners**.
 
• On the **suggestion of a committee **that **includes **the **Prime Minister **serving as **Chairperson**, the **Leader of the Opposition **in the **Lok Sabha**, and **a Union Cabinet Minister **that the **Prime Minister has nominated**, the **President appoints them**.
 
• The **jurisdiction of the Commission extends **over all **Central Public Authorities**.
 
• Until they **turn 65 years old**, whichever **comes first**, the **Chief Information Commissioner **and **each Information Commissioner **shall **serve terms set forth by the Central Government**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Power and Function of CIC**:

 
• To **take complaints **about **information requests **made under **RTI, 2005, **and to **investigate them**.
 
• If there are **adequate grounds**, it may order an **investigation into any matter **(suo-moto power).
 
• The Commission has the **same summoning, requesting of documents, etc**., powers as a civil court when conducting an investigation.
